A fixtures-mode run cannot grade these classes at all (ops24LegsByBucket is built only when not --fixtures, surface-probe.mjs:2915), and without a deploy a live run would re-measure the same unchanged surfaces and produce a byte-similar artifact pretending to be a grade.

whatShipPed.P-339 panel: The card's envelope sentence has exactly one composition site now (apps/property-explorer/api/_lib/setback-table-envelope-wording.ts). The branch that used to claim a codified table while withholding depth-warm geometry no longer says either: it names the table (or the chain's own rule) as the source, states that the outline is drawn for reference by the drawing route, and names place/buildable-envelope as the owner of the envelope's reason. The payload carries reasonOwner: 'place/buildable-envelope'.
whatShipPed.P-341: One reconciler (apps/property-explorer/api/_lib/impervious-governing-figure.ts) applied at the single point every served facets payload passes through (pe-property-atoms.ts, after the record patch, so it reads exactly what is about to be served). Where two figures apply, the lower governs, both are cited with their own source and vintage in envelope.maxImperviousPctSources, and one sentence names both. Where fewer than two apply -- which is every other parcel -- the payload is returned byte-identical and nothing is written.

leave_behind.title: Stop the MCP draw block serving atom_path_pending for parcels whose payload rules the table
leave_behind.measured_evidence: On the artifact of record, 48453:367134 / 48453:239852 / 48309:103015 / 48453:445501 / 48055:27929 / 48209:145880 all serve {state:'refused', reason:'atom_path_pending', reasonDisplayText:'Withheld, setbacks unruled'} in draw.overlays.envelope, while the same tool result's own text row prints 'Setbacks and buildable envelope | 25/5/10/15 ft (F/S/R/C) | Present'. Not a missing location: that payload carries queryPoint {longitude:-97.75715, latitude:30.41603} and the draw frame carries anchor {lat:30.41603, lng:-97.75715}, so the point-seeded derivation ran and returned null after step 1.
sites: artifacts/api-server/src/lib/buildableEnvelope/parcelDrawEnvelopeModel.ts:89 -- tryComposeEnvelopeModelForDraw collapses modelled | declined | unreached into null; give it a discriminated result. parcelDrawEnvelopeModel.test.ts's three null-contract tests are the pinned tests to re-point.
artifacts/api-server/src/lib/parcelDrawFromReads.ts:69 envelopeReason / :77 atomPathPending -- let the route attempt's own outcome win over the bake's stored token
artifacts/api-server/src/lib/parcelDrawStub.ts:545 envelopeOverlay -- the refused branch defaults the reason to atom_path_pending
artifacts/smartsite-mcp/src/propertyExplorer.ts:355-362 -- the gate that decides which reason reaches the overlay
leave_behind.no_vocabulary_work_needed: Read @empressaio/atom-contract/display's VOCABULARY row for atom_path_pending: its own `meaning` is 'Setbacks and the buildable envelope have not been ruled or baked for this jurisdiction yet; no distance or polygon exists to report' -- the exact claim these payloads falsify. The package already carries the honest token for a drawn polygon with a withheld figure (modelled-figure-withheld, a present-state overlay `basis`). So the fix is to follow the route attempt's outcome, not to mint a token, and the dispatch's 'never add a vocabulary copy' is not a blocker.
leave_behind.unknown_to_resolve_first: which step after the point-seeded start returns null -- firstParcelRing at that point, the partner-identity guard, resolveAuthoritativeSetbacks (the P-340 resolver gap seen from the MCP side), labelEdges, or wireStatus !== 'ok'. This is an instrumented question, not a reading question.

leave_behind.title: The card must read the route's resolution; a declaration cannot clear the class
leave_behind.measured_evidence: PANEL-DRAW-TABLE-DISAGREE (surface-probe.mjs:2218-2222) compares the two 4-tuples with zero exemptions. 7 subjects, two mechanisms: five a missing/differing corner axis on the card (48209:140047 card 20/10/25/- vs route 20/10/25/15; 48209:142415, 48209:145880, 48209:166141, 48209:97658 alike) and two a wholly different table (48453:367134, 48453:239852: card 25/5/10/15 vs route 15/3.5/5/10).
leave_behind.mechanisms_considered: hauska-map's codified-setback-from-zoning.ts is a vendored four-city table resolving by exact leading-token match; LDT's route resolves through @workspace/adapters mapDistrict plus R-1 source selection. They will disagree whenever the route's winner comes from a source the card does not carry -- which is what the five corner-axis cases look like. Fix (a): the PE facets BFF reads the route's resolution and echoes its tuple (architecturally consistent -- the BFF already makes an extra /record read per request -- but puts the derivation on the card's hot path). Fix (b): share the most-current resolver into hauska-map, per the standing decision _decisions/2026-09-13_share_the_most_current_setback_resolver.md.
leave_behind.why_not_decided_here: the two differ in blast radius and the dispatch's design question asks for the single reason owner, which P-340 already names; the choice of mirror is the seat's.

leave_behind.title: Two genuine 'chain unreachable' states still carry the atom_path_pending token
leave_behind.detail: Both are reachable only when the property atom chain is absent, so no ruled table exists and the state is honest. Neither was measured firing wrongly. Named because their token is in the probe's GEOMETRY_REFUSAL_PHRASES list: if either fires for a parcel whose route draws, the class returns. Rewording them here would have been churn on an unmeasured state; the seat should decide whether to separate 'chain unreachable' from 'jurisdiction unruled'.

leave_behind.title: Surfaces that read the same payload but are not graded by these classes
leave_behind.detail: The PDF / fact sheet, the share view (pe-share-view) and the dossier export all render envelope text from the same facets payload and none is covered by SAYS-RULES-UNRULED, SAYS-GEOMETRY-WITHHELD, PANEL-DRAW-TABLE-DISAGREE or IMPERVIOUS-DUAL-FIGURE. This lane fixed one composition site and one reconciler, which those surfaces read; but nothing in either repo stops a future surface from composing its own envelope sentence, and there is no guardrail test for that today. That gap is upstream of this dispatch and is the honest answer to the gate's 'what bypasses it'.
